data.title: Tianjin Jinran Public Utilities Announces Board and Committee Changes
data.description:

data.title: Rocket Lab Finalizes Financing for Iridium Acquisition Plan
data.description:
Rocket Lab USA ( (RKLB) ) has issued an announcement.

On September 15, 2026, Rocket Lab said it had completed financing for its pending acquisition of Iridium Communications, expected to close in mid-2027 subject to regulatory approvals. The company finished a $1.944 billion at-the-market equity program, issuing about 29.3 million shares, and plans to use the net proceeds primarily for cash consideration under the Iridium deal, with any excess earmarked for future growth and general corporate purposes.

On the same date, Iridium secured lender consent to amend its $1.775 billion term loan so Rocket Lab’s acquisition would not trigger a change-of-control event, while Rocket Lab USA agreed to provide an unsecured parent guarantee after closing. With the amended credit facility, ATM proceeds and existing liquidity sufficient to fund the transaction and related debt repayments, Rocket Lab terminated a previously arranged $3.6 billion senior secured bridge facility, simplifying and de-risking its capital structure ahead of integrating Iridium’s strong free cash flow into a long-term financing framework.
